date_text: Thu, Jul 23rd • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jul 26th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Fresh from the peaks of the Blue Mountains to the peak of Hotel Sweeney’s Rooftop, Mountain Culture Beer Co. is taking over all 12 taps for one massive weekend. Renowned for pushing boundaries and consistently producing some of Australia’s highest-rated beers, Mountain Culture is bringing an incredible lineup that showcases everything they do best—from juicy, hazy hop bombs to rich barrel-aged stouts, crisp pilsners, bold West Coast styles and even a smooth dark lager to round out the experience. On the taps you’ll find: 🍻Ai Slop – NEIPA 🍫 Kit Kat Stout – Imperial Stout 🥃 Lark Stout – Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout 🐍 Snakes On A Bus – DDH IPA 💰 Cashed Up Bogan – Strong Hazy Pale 🔭 Telescopic – West Coast Pils 🧙 Wizards Well – Cali IPA ⚔️ Preux Chevalier (Kicks) – IPA 🟡 Yellow Brick Road – NEIPA ❓ Status Quo 🍊 Juice Trip 🌑 Note To Self – Dark Lager Whether you’re chasing hop saturation, silky smooth stouts, crisp bitterness or something completely different, this lineup has something for every craft beer lover. Gather your mates, soak up the rooftop views and experience one of Australia’s most celebrated breweries as they take over the taps.
